QuestInfo.name: [Arcana] Blooms Under the Moon
QuestInfo.0: The place closest to the moonlight... Where could that be? Talk to the Small Spirit again.
QuestInfo.1: Plant the Floral Flute cutting in the place closest to the moonlight.
QuestInfo.2: As soon as you plant the Floral Flute cutting under the moonlight, it bloomed and began to play.

default.0: All right, take Floral Flute trimmings to the highest place in the forest!
